description: Create an enterprise MCP action template for an organization-hosted Azure MCP Server endpoint with governed, identity-backed Azure operations access.

ui.helpText: Enterprise template only. Replace the example endpoint with an organization-hosted remote Azure MCP endpoint and keep tools disabled until read-only mode, service namespaces, identity, and audit controls are reviewed.

operatorNotes: SimpleChat should not execute user-supplied local package commands such as npx, dnx, uvx, or Docker for Azure MCP.
Prefer read-only mode and explicit Azure service namespace allowlists before any mutating tools are enabled.
warnings: Azure MCP Server can inspect and potentially mutate Azure resources depending on identity permissions and enabled tools.
Do not enable broad Azure service namespaces or mutating tools until RBAC, OAuth/token handling, and audit requirements are complete.
This template is hidden unless explicitly allowed with a preconfiguration:azure_mcp_server MCP destination policy.
